panels.title: Store can self-fix
panels.description: Open self-fixable issue; the store manager is being guided by the wizard.

panels.title: Technician dispatched
panels.description: Qualified ticket open (hardware fault or manager escalation).

panels.title: Site trips avoided
panels.description: Issues closed by the store itself (SELF_RESOLVED).

panels.title: Controller supply voltage
panels.description: Below 10 V (red line) the engine raises POWER_SUPPLY_ABNORMAL.

panels.title: Perimeter loop impedance
panels.description: Above 10 kOhm (red line) a loop is treated as open circuit -> LOOP_CABLE_DISCONNECTED.
